title: joserfc: Compact JWS size guard allocates attacker-controlled segments before rejection (CVE-2026-119284)
description: The joserfc library version 1.7.4 has a vulnerability in its compact JWS size guard. It allocates attacker-controlled memory segments before validating their size, leading to excessive memory allocation prior to rejecting oversized inputs. This can cause increased memory usage and potentially trigger MemoryError exceptions under constrained environments.
